author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Carson Kelly goes deep Saturday
desc: Carson Kelly went 2-for-4 with a home run, one run scored and one RBI in Saturday's 5-3 win over the Cincinnati Reds.
impact: Kelly hit a 410-foot solo homer off Nick Lodolo in the sixth inning. He has now gone deep in two of his last four games and owns a .250 AVG and 550 SLG in July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Alex Bregman goes yard Saturday
desc: Alex Bregman went 1-for-4 with a home run, a walk, one run scored and two RBI in Saturday's 5-3 win over the Cincinnati Reds.
impact: After going hitless in three straight contests, Bregman snapped the skid by belting a two-run homer off Julian Garcia in the seventh inning. He is now slashing just .167/.244/.333 in July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Michael Busch records three hits Saturday
desc: Michael Busch went 3-for-4 with a double and one run scored in Saturday's 5-3 win over the Cincinnati Reds.
impact: Busch recorded his second three-hit game of the season, with his first coming on Opening Day against the Washington Nationals. He has looked good at the plate lately, recording a hit in three of his last four games while posting a .350 OBP across 34 at-bats in July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Javier Assad gives up two runs Saturday
desc: Javier Assad allowed two runs on sevent hits and no walks while striking out four across five innings in Saturday's 5-3 win over the Cincinnati Reds.
impact: The two runs Assad allowed came on back-to-back home runs to Nathaniel Lowe and Eugenio Suarez in the fourth inning. Aside from that, he turned in another solid outing and has surrendered just two earned runs across two starts in July. For the season, he owns a 4.11 ERA and 1.13 WHIP across 15 appearances.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Nick Lodolo exits early due to blister
desc: Nick Lodolo exited Saturday's game against the Chicago Cubs in the sixth inning due to a blister on his left index finger.
impact: Lodolo looked sharp on Saturday, allowing two runs on five hits while striking out four across five innings before exiting in the sixth inning due to a blister on his left index finger. He will likely require a stint on the injured list after dealing with another blister issue on the same finger during spring training, which delayed his 2026 debut until May 8. The Cincinnati Reds are expected to provide an update on the severity of the injury once he undergoes further examination.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Eury Perez delivers quality start Saturday
desc: Eury Perez allowed two runs on eight hits and two walks while striking out six across six innings in Saturday's 4-1 loss to the Cleveland Guardians.
impact: While Perez allowed a season-high eight hits on Saturday, he was able to limit the Guardians to just two runs. He has now allowed two earned runs or fewer in five consecutive starts and owns a 3.78 ERA and 1.14 WHIP on the season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Liam Hicks swipes bag Saturday
desc: Liam Hicks went 2-for-3 with an RBI and a stolen base in Saturday's 4-1 loss to the Cleveland Guardians.
impact: Hicks stole second base off Tanner Bibee in the second inning but was unable to come around and score. He has been excellent in July, posting a .350 batting average with nine runs scored and five RBI.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Casey Schmitt goes yard in win over Rockies
desc: Casey Schmitt went 1-for-4 in a win over the Rockies with a three-run home run.
impact: Schmitt continues a solid stretch at the plate of late, picking up hits in seven of his last 10 contests. The 27-year-old continues to flash his explosive power stroke as one of many streaky bats in the Giants lineup for manager Tony Vitello, carrying an .809 OPS with 19 home runs, 50 RBI, 42 runs scored, and seven stolen bases through 87 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Tyler Mahle grinds through seven in win over Rockies
desc: Tyler Mahle allowed one earned run on five hits and three walks while striking out four through seven innings in Saturday's win over the Rockies.
impact: Mahle has offered mixed results on the mound of late, allowing less than three earned runs in two of his last four trips to the mound. The right-hander remains one of the more underwhelming options in the Giants rotation for manager Tony Vitello, posting a 5.31 ERA and 1.46 WHIP with a 2-8 record and 8.4 K/9 ratio through 15 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kyle Karros goes deep in loss to Giants
desc: Kyle Karros went 1-for-4 in Saturday's loss to the Giants with a solo home run.
impact: Karros continues a dynamic stretch of late, extending his on-base streak to 19 games in Saturday's loss. The 23-year-old offers manager Warren Shaeffer one of the more reliable bats as part of an inconsistent Rockies lineup to this point, carrying an .809 OPS with nine home runs, 34 RBI, 47 runs scored, and three stolen bases through 92 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kyle Freeland labors on mound in loss to Giants
desc: Kyle Freeland allowed four earned runs on six hits while striking out nine over six innings in a loss to the Giants.
impact: Freeland continues a dismal stretch on the mound, allowing three earned runs or more in 10 of his last 11 trips to the mound. The left-hander remains another disappointing option in the Rockies rotation for manager Warren Schaeffer, posting a 7.36 ERA and 1.57 WHIP with a 2-8 record and 8.1 K/9 ratio through 17 starts.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Griffin Jax picks up win Saturday
desc: Griffin Jax allowed one run on four hits and three walks while striking out three across five innings in Saturday's 6-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners.
impact: While Jax issued three walks, his most since allowing four in his May 13 start against the Toronto Blue Jays, he was still able to limit Seattle to one run. A big reason for his success was his ability to avoid hard contact, as he allowed just three singles and a double. Through 14 starts this season, Jax owns a 2.80 ERA and 1.13 WHIP and is worth a waiver wire add if still available.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Ryan Vilade hits pinch-hit homer Saturday
desc: Ryan Vilade went 1-for-1 with a three-run home run in Saturday's 6-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners.
impact: Vilade pinch-hit for Cedric Mullins III in the seventh inning with left-hander Gabe Speier entering the game and delivered a 387-foot home run to left field, extending the Tampa Bay Rays' lead to four runs. Despite the big swing, he has gone just 1-for-12 in limited action in July and is best left on waivers for now. While he owns a solid .794 OPS on the season, his lack of consistent playing time limits his fantasy value.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Shane Drohan grinds through traffic in loss to Pirates
desc: Shane Drohan allowed three earned runs on five hits while striking out six through 6 1/3 innings in Saturday's loss to the Pirates.
impact: Drohan has provided mixed results on the mound of late, allowing three runs or more in four of his last eight trips to the mound. The left-hander remains one of many reliable arms as part of a deep Milwaukee starting staff for manager Pat Murphy, posting a 3.09 ERA and 1.20 WHIP with a 4-3 record, two holds, one save, and an 8.6 K/9 ratio through 19 appearances.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Junior Caminero swipes bag Saturday
desc: Junior Caminero went 1-for-2 with a double, two walks, one run scored and a stolen base in Saturday's 6-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners.
impact: While Caminero was unable to homer for a third straight game, he still delivered for fantasy managers by reaching base safely three times and recording his second stolen base of the season. He leads all third basemen with 28 home runs and .933 OPS on the year.
